name: How long does it take to complete an accessible kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete an accessible kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for an accessible kitchen remodel depends on its complexity. A basic remodel involving fixture replacements and minor modifications might take 4-8 weeks. More extensive renovations, including layout changes, custom cabinetry, and significant plumbing or electrical work, could extend to 10-16 weeks or longer. This timeline typically includes design, material procurement, and construction phases. Our team will provide a detailed project schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: An accessible kitchen remodel can take 4-8 weeks for minor updates or 10-16+ weeks for extensive renovations, depending on complexity.
